hooks.name: Keep the status and task list current
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, reminds it to update AGENTS.md and tasks.md, confirm the checks ran, and respect the steering rules.

action.prompt: Before you finish: if this turn changed code or behaviour, make sure the Status in AGENTS.md and .kiro/specs/scary-money-manager/tasks.md describe the change, that npm run build, npm test and npm run test:e2e were run and passed (or say which did not), and that no decision in .kiro/steering/rules.md was changed without the user's approval.
